sources.brief: Three isolated modular components: gray robot host with green eye and side sockets possessed by black/red symbiote; matching separate claws.
Massive black alien symbiote torso with ivory eyes and crimson fissures, plus independent left and right talon arms.
Black symbiote possession of the Furnace Tyrant, preserving the mechanical face, orange mouth and shoulder identity.
South-facing possessed Stage 1 helicopter hull plus separate X rotor; preserve long tail, rocket wings and canopy identity.
4x4 aligned transparent cells: exclusive rupture sequence, fragment reformation, binary bolt/data bomb/dark-matter orb/tentacle spear, and portal opening/closure.
3x2 transparent cells: intact/cracked/breaking alien binary wall, plus intact/cracked/breaking fitted binary shield with an open center.
